summary: Iteration 5 full-stack QA of (A) admin Sales Analytics and (B) Product Variants, plus light regression. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 9 new tests (TestSalesAnalytics x3, TestVariants x6); full suite 62/62 PASSED. Frontend: Playwright-verified admin dashboard analytics, storefront variant selector + stock messaging, cart variant separation/qty/remove, checkout per-variant oversell 400 surfaced as toast, Razorpay modal opening, admin variants editor (prefill/add/remove/auto-sum), non-variant product path, coupon rounding and admin order-status persistence. No functional defects found; only testability/UX gaps listed below.

minor.issue: Called without size/color it deletes EVERY line of that product. Harmless today (Cart.jsx always passes the variant), but a client omitting the params silently wipes all variant lines of the product.

best_sellers is keyed by item NAME (not product_id), so two products sharing a name would merge, and variants of one product are aggregated into a single row (intended per spec, but name-keying is fragile). Also `revenue` (order totals after discount) and best_sellers `revenue` (gross line totals) are computed on different bases, so the two panels never reconcile.

ui_bugs.issue: Variant lines of the SAME product reuse identical data-testids (cart-item-<pid>, cart-variant-<pid>, cart-qty-<pid>, cart-qty-plus/minus-<pid>, remove-<pid>) so two lines produce duplicate testids; tests must fall back to .nth(). Suffix with the variant key (e.g. cart-item-<pid>-M-Ivory).
Order line items never render the variant, although the backend persists items[].variant. A customer/admin cannot tell which size/color was purchased on an order.
No data-testid on address inputs, coupon input, Apply, Pay button, per-order status dropdowns (16 role=combobox with no testid) or auth form fields; tests must rely on placeholders/text.

issues: An unavailable size+color combination (e.g. XS + Rose) reports the generic 'Out of stock' instead of 'This combination is unavailable'; unavailable sizes/colors are also not visually disabled for the current selection, so users hunt for valid pairs.
Chart renders 14 points but only 7 x-axis tick labels (every other day) and no data dots, so a single-day spike reads as a vertical wall; consider showing dots or a tooltip hint.

action_items: Render items[].variant on customer Orders and admin Orders line items (MEDIUM).
Make cart data-testids variant-unique (append size/color) to remove duplicate testids.
Show a distinct 'Combination unavailable' state and disable impossible size/color pairs on ProductDetail.
Require size/color on DELETE /api/cart/{id} for variant products (or delete only the matching line) to avoid accidentally clearing all variant lines.
Add data-testid to checkout address/coupon/pay controls and admin order-status dropdowns.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_payment decrements variants.$[v].stock AND stock in one $inc; because _prep_product recomputes stock as the variant sum on read, the stored stock field is now redundant/derived - keep one source of truth to avoid drift for products that later lose their variants.

checkout uses i['variant_stock'] computed at read time with no atomic reservation; two concurrent checkouts on the same variant can both pass the guard and drive variant stock negative. Use a conditional $inc ({'variants': {$elemMatch: {size, color, stock: {$gte: qty}}}}) at verify time.
admin_stats loads up to 1000 paid orders into memory and can issue a per-item products.find_one for legacy items with no category - move to an aggregation pipeline before order volume grows.
server.py is 821 lines; split routers (products/cart/orders/admin/email) into modules.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (analytics, variant select, cart separation, oversell, admin editor, regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this iteration: GET /api/admin/stats returns daily_revenue (exactly 14 chronological {date:'MM-DD',revenue} points, last = today UTC) and best_sellers (<=5, sorted by qty desc, keys name/qty/revenue/image). Storefront: 'Ivory Wrap Midi Dress' shows variant-selectors, stock-status 'Select options to check availability' -> 'In stock . 6 available' (M/Ivory) / 'In stock . 2 available' (L/Rose); Add to Bag before selection toasts 'Please select all options'; XS+Rose -> 'Out of stock' + button disabled. Cart shows 2 separate lines with labels 'M . Ivory' / 'L . Rose', + increments only that line (subtotal 7,497), trash removes only that line. Checkout with L/Rose x3 toasts 'Only 2 left of Ivory Wrap Midi Dress (L Rose)'; at qty 2 with WELCOME10 total 4,998-500=4,498 and the Razorpay checkout modal opens (rzp test-mode key). Admin Inventory edit prefills 5 variant rows and form-stock 24; add-variant-btn/remove work and total auto-sums (10 -> 4 after removing a row). Non-variant 'Ceramic Pour-Over Set' shows no variant-selectors and adds directly. Admin order status change to shipped persists after reload; the 858 WELCOME10 order is visible. NOT tested: a real completed Razorpay payment (LIVE keys) - variant stock decrement was proven via the /orders/verify path in pytest (TestVariants::test_variant_stock_decrement_on_paid) instead. Note: admin Inventory delete uses window.confirm, which Playwright auto-dismisses - accept the dialog explicitly.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect required RCA. The one earlier test failure ('Please complete your address') was a test-script bug: the checkout address placeholder is exactly 'Address', not 'Address line'; fixed in the script and the oversell guard then reproduced correctly.
